plan: I believe the target is the classical Gyan/Chin mudra (knowledge mudra): the tip of the thumb touches the tip of the index finger forming a small circle; the other three fingers (middle, ring, little) are extended and held straight and close together; the palm faces the audience and the fingers point upward. To achieve this: thumb should be opposed toward the index (thumb_cmc_flex moderate positive, thumb_cmc_abd negative to press toward index), thumb_mcp and thumb_ip moderately flexed so tip meets index tip. Index finger should have small-to-moderate flexion at mcp/pip/dip to curve the fingertip to meet the thumb. Middle/ring/little should be mostly straight (mcp near 0, pip/dip near 0) and not widely splayed (abductions near 0). Hand orientation: palm facing the front camera, fingers vertical; slight yaw so the thumb-index circle is visible in three_quarter view. I'll now set those joint targets and refine with a few looks.
